text:
maya: quick design heads-up — exploring a compact "chips" pattern for the Usage page cost composition instead of dense ledger rows. idea is to show per-project cost breakdown as chips (model fee, infra, embeddings) with a lightweight sparkline, and an explicit ‘expand to ledger’ action. would help scanability on mobile. thoughts? josh: I like scanability, especially for org overview. main concerns: invoices and CSV exports — chips are hard to map 1:1 to rows for export. also how do we show token-level detail for debugging? :thinking_face: liam: engineering constraints to call out: virtualization and keyboard navigation. chips are fine but we need clear focus states and an accessible expand that doesn't fetch a ton of extra data by default. prefer progressive fetch (on expand). also need to consider SSR for first paint. nora: from analytics POV: if we swap to chips we should keep a deterministic mapping so exports and time-series rollups still work. metrics to watch: time-to-find-cost, invoice-download-rate, and export-success-rate. also request: per-token delta for top 3 queries in the expanded ledger. maya: agreed re export. proposal: chips for the compact row + an unambiguous chevron that expands into the ledger table below the row (not a modal). chips content example: ```html
▂▅▇▂▁
``` The ledger rows remain in DOM when expanded so CSV/export can use the same row mapping. fallback for screenreaders: `aria-expanded` + `aria-live` region announcing expansion. design-bot: accessibility-scan: contrast-warning on .chip-bg (#bdbdbd on white), suggest increasing contrast or adding 1px outline for focus. also flag: ensure chips are keyboard-focusable (tabindex) and support Enter/Space activation. josh: ok on expand-in-place. for invoices we should keep a persistent "Download CSV" for each project in the expanded state and an account-level export that flattens chips -> canonical rows. that way exports aren't ambiguous. also how does invoice PDF show chips vs rows? prefer rows in PDFs. nora: hybrid approach makes sense: default view = chips (compact), click expand = ledger rows + export CTA. for experiments we can A/B test default collapsed vs default expanded for accounts with >10 projects. metrics: invoice-downloads per session, mean expand-rate, and overflow click-to-export. liam: performance note: token breakdowns are heavy. suggest lazy fetch with a short TTL cache per project. avoid N+1 by fetching token aggregates in batches for the visible viewport. also we should implement virtualization for the ledger when expanded (large orgs). maya: acceptance criteria draft: 1) compact view reduces vertical space by >=40% for accounts with >5 projects; 2) invoice-download rate changes <5% (no regression); 3) keyboard-only users can open expand and trigger export within 3 key presses. if the A/B crosses these, roll forward. josh: i'll own the A/B setup and shipping instrumentation. tagging @nora to build dashboards for the metrics above. nora: will add metrics and a sample dashboard. also will collect session recordings for qualitative check on scanability. maya: action items: - design: finalize chip visuals + focus states (maya) - eng: lazy fetch + virtualization plan (liam) - product: A/B hypothesis + launch plan (josh) - analytics: metrics + dashboard (nora) Can we sync tomorrow at 10am PT for a 30m design review? :calendar: josh: +1, booked. maya: thanks — will drop updated mocks and contrast fixes before the meeting. :sparkles:
